_about: B6 batch glossary (concepts/sandbox-and-execution, concepts/approval-and-interaction, concepts/acp-sdk-and-clients). Owner: B6 writer. Searched core.json, b2.json, b4.json, b5.json first; sandbox, capability-seam, approval-policy and acp already exist in core.json and are reused with {{term ...}}.

sandbox-escalation.short: A one-shot retry of a denied call at a strictly wider sandbox mode, granted only after the user approves it.
sandbox-escalation.long: Repeating the call's current mode needs no approval; a strictly wider target goes through ctx.approval before anything executes ({{cite packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts:172-180}}).

sdk-wire-protocol.short: dsh's own newline-delimited JSON-RPC protocol, one message per line, served over stdio and spoken by the Node and Python SDKs.
